data.name: Codex-Named Unit (ability_inner_sea_gods_isg_abilities_faith_lst_59)
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, your dark patron rewards your faith with a few drops of devilish blood in your veins, granting you a measure of the resilience enjoyed by devilkind. Your skin takes on a ruddy cast, and your teeth grow slightly sharper. To a casual observer you may look no different, but anyone who studies you closely notices these traits. You gain fire resistance 10 and a +4 profane bonus on saving throws against poison.
